label: saga
expect:
OK=committed
ST1=held/charged/sent
DUP=dup
ST1B=held/charged/sent
FAIL_PAY=aborted
ST2=cancelled/none/none
FAIL_SHIP=aborted
ST3=cancelled/refunded/none
COUNT=4
user_extra: idemp.aura MUST define (idemp-init), (idemp-seen? key), (idemp-mark key). journal.aura MUST define (journal-init), (journal-append step status), (journal-last), (journal-has? step status). book.aura MUST define (book-init), (book-reserve key room) returning ok|dup|fail (fail if room full; dup if idemp seen), (book-cancel key), (book-state). pay.aura MUST define (pay-init), (pay-charge key amount) fail on bad/0, (pay-refund key), (pay-state). ship.aura MUST define (ship-init), (ship-send key dest) fail on blocked, (ship-recall key), (ship-state). step.aura MUST define (run-step name thunk-result) journaling the result. compensate.aura MUST define (compensate-from step): pay→book-cancel; ship→pay-refund+book-cancel; book→noop; return comped|noop. saga.aura MUST define (saga-init) and (saga-run sid room amount dest): idemp key per step via sid; book→pay→ship; on fail compensate-from + abort; on success commit; if journal already committed for sid return dup. query.aura MUST define (saga-status) as book/pay/ship states joined by /. main.aura MUST run the GOAL scenario and print OK/ST1/DUP/ST1B/FAIL_PAY/ST2/FAIL_SHIP/ST3/COUNT=4. Named fences required for idemp.aura, journal.aura, book.aura, pay.aura, ship.aura, step.aura, compensate.aura, saga.aura, query.aura, main.aura in that order. Aura run: `aura idemp.aura journal.aura book.aura pay.aura ship.aura step.aura compensate.aura saga.aura query.aura main.aura`.
